# The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Constructive Data Modeling

> An exact, time-indexed Foldkit companion to Alexis King's Software Should Work 2026 talk.

The companion has all 158 authored reveal pages plus the recording's question-and-answer tail. Every reveal has an exact recording start and end time, a YouTube deep link, its logical slide, and its condensed-page locator. The deliberate return from generic `Ior` to the domain-named `UserContact` slide is preserved.

The embedded YouTube recording and authored pages synchronize in both directions: choosing a page seeks the recording, and playback crossing a reveal boundary selects the corresponding page. Stable pages can also be selected with `?page=<1-158>`. Press G for the authored Goto Page chooser, whose default landmarks exactly match the talk source: Title, Introduction, Static typing, Positive space, Obligation propagation, and Conclusion. Its All Pages mode exposes every reveal. Browser, command-line, terminal, and future remote-control hosts consume the same renderer-neutral Model and Message union.

## Primary sources
